inspection_scope: Official versioned publisher PDF text inspected on 2026-10-19: p.1 license; p.3 section 2.1/Table 1; pp.4-5 sections 2.2-2.2.2/Tables 2-3; pp.5-6 section 2.3.2; p.10 Table 5 and statistical/theoretical-density discussion. Selected Hostatron/paraffin recipe rows and rho_geom cells were checked against their text column headings and repeated source reads. Screenshot calls did not yield a viewable image in this execution environment; no new visual cross-check or PDF-byte hash verification is claimed. No raw-data reanalysis or independent scientific validation.
recipe_unit_basis: phr as reported, per 100 parts Vistalon 2504 rubber; this basis is not nominal wt% of the compound.
nominal_composition_qualification: Table 3 presents RT70HC columns in phr, wt% and vv%, whereas section 2.2 describes the nominal PCM percentages with respect to the EPDM compound and the sample-code paragraph describes percentage in the sample. These are distinct source representations with an unresolved percentage-denominator scope; the stated percentages are not percentages per 100 parts of raw EPDM. Preserve the printed phr and nominal wt% separately without conversion, renormalization or a measured final-composition claim. The final cured composition and residual blowing-agent products were not assayed in the selected passages.

identity_policy: Three separately prepared Hostatron/paraffin formulations, distinguished by 33.0, 87.0 and 196.0 phr RT70HC. Production routes, specimen replicates, test conditions and translated names do not create additional identities. Finished-composite grade_id remains null; constituent supplier designations are not finished-product grades.

duplicate_check.decision: The base EPDM/N550 identity is actually classified composite in the inspected a592c89 catalog. It contains no added paraffin or blowing agent. The three selected Hostatron/paraffin formulations are absent. NC1/NC2 and PBS B10/B20/B30 are existing unrelated identities; none is repeated.
